Broncos vs. Cardinals: Denver has dominated the series history
stories.summary: The Denver Broncos have dominated their all-time series against the Arizona Cardinals. The Broncos and Cardinals have played just 12 times in the regular season in their team histories; the first matchup happened between the then-St. Louis Cardinals and the Broncos in 1973, a game which produced the series' only tie, a 17-17 draw. After their second-ever game in 1977, the matchup took a 12-year hiatus before resuming in 1989. It has been played on a more regular basis since then. The Broncos lead the all-time series between the two teams 10-1-1 , outscoring the Cardinals all-time by a margin of 184 points (358-174), per The Football Database .

The NFL breaks new ground this weekend with its first game in France, as the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints battle in Paris. This will be the sixth international game of the young season already, and the fourth game that takes place in Europe. However, as the last three European contests were played in the familiar backdrop of London, this one will officially be the NFL's inaugural French game. The league is treating this game similarly to its London games, which means it will take place early in the morning in the United States. Therefore, the Steelers and Saints will get a standalone broadcast when they kick off on Sunday.
